tickGrowth.description: Fraction added to tick damage per second the status has held.

tickHeal.description: Health restored per tick; buff counterpart to tickDamage.

procDamage.description: Burst dealt on the tick where a build-up meter fills.

stackDecay.description: Sheds one stack per duration instead of expiring outright.

expireStatusId.description: Status applied when this one runs out.

stunPulse.description: Re-applies the stun window once per tick interval instead of once.

buildUpThreshold.description: Meter value that must be reached before the status takes hold.

buildUpDecay.description: Meter drained per second once the grace window has passed.

buildUpResistGain.description: Added to the threshold each time the meter fills.

stats.description: Stat totals contributed while active; buff counterpart to relic stats.

iconColor.description: Damage-number tint only; status icons use authored atlas pixels.
